grade.answer_reason: Says yes and names the 5,000-part limit from the Corvane gateway 2.3 docs. It computes about 7,153–7,680 parts at 8 MiB and changes CHUNK_MB in scripts/upload.sh to 32 MiB, which is above the 12–13 MiB minimum and inside the 8–512 MiB range. It also says to re-check the limit if the gateway is no longer on 2.3.
